_readme: TurfScore = sum of weight * factor (each factor 0-1). Weights should total 100. Tune these from field results, not from code.

targeting._readme: Filters a rep can mix and match on the map. Picking none in a group means any. Home age uses the median year built of 1-4 family lots in NYC (PLUTO), else ACS B25035; walk lists filter each house by its own year. A tract is flagged renter-heavy when renter-occupied households are at least renter_heavy_share. Homeowner age uses ACS B25007 brackets (15-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-74, 75-84, 85+), so band edges must fall on those. House size uses building square feet where NYC lot data exists, otherwise ACS median rooms.
